name: Ordifolio – PDF Product Catalog for WooCommerce
author: ifritdmc

sections.description:
Ordifolio turns your WooCommerce products – or a simple CSV/Excel export – into a professional PDF product catalog in one click. Add your logo and brand colors, group products by category and let customers download the catalog with a button or the [ordifolio_catalog] shortcode.

Perfect for wholesalers, B2B price lists, trade fairs, shops that send catalogs by email or WhatsApp, restaurants and any business that needs a printable product list.

Free features

  • WooCommerce or CSV input – use your store products or upload a CSV (comma or semicolon, UTF-8 or Excel/Windows encoding).
  • No product limit – large catalogs are built step by step and split into PDF parts when needed.
  • Your logo and colors – main and accent color pickers.
  • Grouped by category, with images, SKU, price and short description.
  • Download button / shortcode: [ordifolio_catalog label="Download our catalog"].
  • Full UTF-8 support: accents, ñ, ç, €, « » … render correctly (embedded DejaVu fonts).
  • Light on resources: products are read in batches of 100, thumbnails are used and big catalogs are rendered in parts, so it runs on modest shared hosting without timeouts.
  • No external services: the PDF is generated on your own server; nothing is sent to third parties.
  • Spanish and English interface.
  • Optional, off-by-default “Made with Ordifolio” credit.

Ordifolio Pro

  • Sector templates (restaurant menu, fashion lookbook, industrial/spare parts)
  • Print quality (300 DPI)
  • Multiple catalogs (by category) with their own shortcode
  • Automatic background regeneration with WP-Cron on a schedule (daily/weekly), so the PDF is always up to date
  • Cover page and index
  • Priority support

Plans: 49 €/year (1 site), 99 €/year (5 sites), 199 €/year (unlimited sites).

Español

Ordifolio crea un catálogo PDF de tus productos de WooCommerce o de un archivo CSV, con tu logotipo y colores, agrupado por categorías y con botón de descarga. Ideal para tarifas de precios, mayoristas, ferias y tiendas que envían catálogos por email o WhatsApp.

Third-party libraries

  • Dompdf (LGPL-2.1) – https://github.com/dompdf/dompdf
  • php-font-lib, php-svg-lib (LGPL), Sabberworm PHP CSS Parser (MIT), Masterminds HTML5 (MIT)
  • DejaVu fonts (Bitstream Vera license, free)
  • Freemius WordPress SDK 2.13.4 (GPL-3.0) – https://github.com/Freemius/wordpress-sdk
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from Plugins → Add New.
  2. Go to PDF Catalog in the admin menu.
  3. Choose the product source (WooCommerce or CSV), upload your logo and pick your colors.
  4. Click Generate PDF now.
  5. Add [ordifolio_catalog] to any page or post to show the download button.
sections.faq:
Does it need WooCommerce?

No. Without WooCommerce you can use a CSV file with the columns name, sku, price, category, description, image (or Spanish: nombre, referencia, precio, categoria, descripcion, imagen).

Are accents, ñ and the € sign supported?

Yes. The PDF embeds DejaVu fonts with full UTF-8 coverage, and Excel CSV files in Windows-1252 are converted automatically.

Is there a product limit?

No. The free version includes every product. Very large catalogs (more than 1,000 products by default, filter ordifolio_volume_size) are split into several PDF parts and the shortcode shows one button per part.

Where is the PDF stored?

In wp-content/uploads/ordifolio/. The file is public so visitors can download it via the shortcode.

How do I get support?

Use the WordPress.org support forum or write to ifritalexis@gmail.com. Pro customers get priority email support.

Does the plugin collect any data?

Only if you opt in. On activation Ordifolio (via the Freemius SDK) asks whether you want to share non-sensitive diagnostic data and receive updates; you can skip it and the plugin works the same. Licensing and payments for Pro are handled by Freemius.

Will it work on cheap hosting?

Yes. Generation runs in small steps: products are read 100 at a time and the PDF is rendered in parts of up to 1,000 products, so each request stays short and light. Thumbnails are used instead of full-size images and remote resources are disabled.

Which images can be used from a CSV?

Only images that already exist in your Media Library (paste their URL). Remote images are never downloaded.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Free version has no product limit: catalogs of any size are generated step by step (no timeouts) and split into PDF parts when very large.
  • PDF styles moved to template .css files loaded through Dompdf’s stylesheet API.
  • Translations are now provided by translate.wordpress.org language packs.

1.0.0

  • First release.
